name: Transition mix
doc: Mixes a into b with one of the registered transitions (lab/transitions/, `type` = registry index) at progress p. The show graph drives it from the room's schedule; inside a scene, bind p to a signal.

type.doc: transition kind: index in the registry (core ones 0..13 as before: 1 blend, 3 wipe, ...)

pads.doc: center the transitions on the pads' FX center

changelog.note: pluggable transitions: the shader is assembled from lab/transitions/*/mix.wgsl; type is an int (registry index, the old enum values unchanged); time uniform; bands always uploaded
